newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-SWEDEN'S ERIKSSON TO SIGN FOR SUNDERLAND.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SWEDEN'S ERIKSSON TO SIGN FOR SUNDERLAND.

text.p: English premier league club Sunderland are expected to complete the signing of Swedish international Jan Eriksson for 250,000 pounds ($420,000) on Tuesday.
The 29-year-old defender, a member of the Helsinborg side which knocked Aston Villa out of the UEFA Cup earlier this season, held talks with Sunderland manager Peter Reid in London on Saturday.
"I think he will do us a lot of good," Reid said.
